prs.title: Editorial: Correct the close watcher cancel action return value
prs.author: JinDX
prs.body:
Correct the cancel action contract to require true when its boolean argument is false. A true result allows the close request to proceed, while false prevents it.

This agrees with the request-to-close assertion that a false result requires canPreventClose to be true, and with the existing popover cancel action.

Spec: https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/interaction.html#close-watcher-cancel-action

prs.title: Editorial: Pass true to the classic worker import fetch hook
prs.author: JinDX
prs.body:
Pass true as the fetch-hook flag for a classic worker-imported script. The algorithm currently refers to an isTopLevel variable that is neither a parameter nor a local binding.

The fetch-hook contract already states that the flag is true for all classic script fetches.

Spec: https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/webappapis.html#fetch-a-classic-worker-imported-script

prs.title: Editorial: Inspect close watcher groups when checking activity
prs.author: JinDX
prs.body:
Check the groups member of the close watcher manager when determining whether a close watcher is active. The manager itself is a struct; its groups member is the list of close-watcher lists.

This supplies the missing list operand for the existing contains operation.

Spec: https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/interaction.html#close-watcher-active

prs.title: Editorial: Fix the rgba-float16 reference in ImageData initialization
prs.author: JinDX
prs.body:
Link the rgba-float16 value in ImageData initialization to dom-ImageDataPixelFormat-rgba-float16.

The current reference displays rgba-float16 but points to the rgba-unorm8 definition.

Spec: https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/imagebitmap-and-animations.html#initialize-an-imagedata-object
